paragraphs.text: Grandchild is a unique acorn class used for cards which depict the child of a child of another creature.

Grandchild debuted as a creature type in Unsanctioned as a reference to the Child type that had previously debuted in Unglued . Thus far, the type has only been used once, though grandchildren have been mentioned in the flavor text of other cards.
Infernius Spawnington III, Esq. is the Grandchild of the Infernal Spawn of Evil and the child of the Infernal Spawn of Infernal Spawn of Evil .
